# Solid Oak Tree Care

> Professional tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, and emergency storm response in Buffalo, NY.

Solid Oak Tree Care is a locally owned and operated arborist services company serving Buffalo, NY and the surrounding Western New York communities.

## Services

- [Tree Removal](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
- [Stump Grinding & Removal](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
- [Emergency Tree Service](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
- [Land Clearing](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
- [Tree Health & Arborist Consulting](https://solidoaktreecare.com/services)
